exact_feature_definition: AtmaKaraka (highest within-sign degree) and PutraKaraka (sixth-highest) are 1/4/7/10 signs apart in D1 or D9, using sidereal Lahiri and mean nodes
effect_summary: 60/84 versus 3025/5460 permuted; Fisher one-sided p=.00205; secondary probit slopes p=.043/.017
definition_risk: software and D1/D9 construction must be frozen from the paper
development_decision: eligible only as a predeclared exploratory candidate; zero prior production weight

exact_feature_definition: for an otherwise identical aspect, allow maximum applying orb to exceed separating orb by a candidate 1–2 degrees
outcome_domain: unspecified across four >50,000-chart applications in publisher abstract
effect_summary: abstract reports no consistent tight-vs-wide effect but recurring 1–2° applying allowance
replication_status: full text unavailable; independence and exact results unverified
definition_risk: exact aspect set, outcome and base-rate controls unknown
development_decision: interaction-only secondary moderator; cannot receive evidence-derived weight

exact_feature_definition: publisher abstract claims an adjusted planetary-dominance score matched charts to biographies in an independent 61-biography sample; exact score unavailable
replication_status: described as independent replication, but full methods/results unavailable
definition_risk: feature-generation, blinding, labels and multiplicity cannot be audited
development_decision: reconstruct only after full text; prospectively freeze and independently code

exact_feature_definition: replace each tropical sign with its opposite for Southern Hemisphere births before automated semantic matching
effect_summary: abstract: N=141; inversion match 70.5% south vs 35.6% north; p≈1.62e-5; h≈.72
definition_risk: Mastro Expert/Semantic Proximity pipeline and ~150 traits per person not fully available
development_decision: not eligible until full method is reproduced and held out

exact_feature_definition: conjunction or opposition of Mars with Moon, Sun, Mercury or Venus (eight tests total)
effect_summary: abstract: 3/8 nominal effects in N=620, combined p=1.94e-4 h=.144; 4/8 in N=751, combined p=4.30e-8 h=.191
definition_risk: orbs, control birth distribution, record quality, duplication and combination method unavailable
development_decision: explicitly excluded from product/clinical/person-level inference; research audit only

exact_feature_definition: planet-specific diurnal key-sector occupancy for predeclared eminent professions under frozen sector and eligibility definitions
effect_summary: long programme contains reported excesses and failed/disputed replications; selection-index reanalyses themselves conflict
replication_status: multiple nominal replications but datasets, admission criteria and reanalyses overlap
definition_risk: sector boundaries, eminence cutoffs, control construction and sample inclusion are contested
development_decision: no production weight; only a preregistered programme-level replication with independent records

exact_feature_definition: continuous aspect distance and angularity entered only as moderators of a pre-frozen aspect-to-trait mapping
effect_summary: Startup broad continuous study was null (3/32 nominal; family p=.21); 2022 abstract suggests applying/separating asymmetry, not generic tightness
definition_risk: mapping and orb family must be frozen before outcomes
development_decision: retain solely as preregistered secondary moderator, never primary success endpoint

exact_feature_definition: human Vedic astrologer judgment from a natal chart using Varāhamihira-style rules
effect_summary: reported sensitivity/specificity ≈77–82%, but current-illness inter-rater κ=-.111 on only 10 shared charts
development_decision: excluded from clinical/personal inference; no model feature
